title: draw_messages slice over range instead of scroll is correct and more efficient
description: The new draw_messages slices state.messages.range(top..end) and renders only the visible window, replacing an approach that formatted all N messages then asked Paragraph to scroll. A contributor might suggest reverting to .iter() + scroll for 'simplicity'. The range approach is strictly better: O(visible) instead of O(N) formatting, and it removes the scroll coordinate mismatch that existed when message lines wrapped (Paragraph scroll counts render-rows, not message-items). The slice approach is also simpler to reason about — what you pass to Paragraph is exactly what is rendered.
